description: Recorded licences for bundled proprietary fonts whose own metadata names no licence (docs/decisions.md A-21, P-09). Read by scripts/generate-licenses.mjs; a record covers only the listed file hashes. Two record states. Full: {name, sha256: [..], license: "LicenseRef-Commercial-Font", licensor, licensee, scope (must name app and web embedding), evidence (where the signed licence is held), recordedOn}; the entry is then unflagged. Owner statement: {name, sha256: [..], license: "LicenseRef-Commercial-Font", evidence: "held-outside-repository", holder, basis, recordedOn, optional reference}; it records only what the owner stated, no licence name, number, scope or terms, and the entry stays flagged proprietary-licence-held-outside-repo. `reference` may later point at the licence document (a reference only: never the document itself and no secrets).

entries.name: Denton typeface
entries.basis: owner states the licence is held; the licence document is kept outside this repository
